s.note: the casino lounge where Deloris sings
s.how: Remove the stems from 20 button mushrooms and chop the stems. Fry with 2 rashers diced bacon and 1 crushed garlic clove, then mix with 1/2 cup breadcrumbs and 50g grated parmesan. Fill the caps and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.

s.note: the choir's tea break after rehearsal
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour, then stir in 150g grated vintage cheddar, chopped chives and a pinch of cayenne. Mix in 300ml milk to a soft dough. Pat out, cut into rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve warm with butter.

m.note: the bland convent dinner Deloris can't believe
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add 2 onions, crushed garlic, a spoon of smoked paprika and thyme. Pour in stock, a can of tomatoes and a splash of hot sauce. Braise for 3 hours, adding potatoes and carrots for the last hour. Proper flavour this time.

w.note: the sisters never waste a loaf
w.how: Butter 8 slices of white bread, cut into triangles and layer in a dish with 80g sultanas. Whisk 3 eggs, 500ml milk, 100ml cream, 70g sugar and 1 tsp vanilla, pour over and soak 20 minutes. Sprinkle with nutmeg and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until puffed and golden.

d.n: Choir practice honey ginger lemon tea
d.how: Slice a 5cm knob of ginger and simmer in 1.2L water with a cinnamon stick for 10 minutes. Turn off the heat, add 4 black tea bags and steep for 4 minutes, then remove the bags. Stir in the juice of a lemon and 4 tbsp honey. Pour into plain white cups and float a thin lemon slice in each.
